claims: Detroit Red Wings are a professional NHL team.
Detroit Red Wings are based in Detroit, Michigan.
Detroit Red Wings compete in the Atlantic Division of the Eastern Conference.
Detroit Red Wings were founded in 1926.
Detroit Red Wings are one of the Original Six teams.
Detroit Red Wings play at Little Caesars Arena.
As of 2026, Detroit Red Wings are fighting for a playoff berth.
Detroit Red Wings have won 11 Stanley Cups.
Detroit Red Wings have won the most Stanley Cups of any U.S.-based NHL franchise.
Detroit Red Wings history features hall-of-famer Gordie Howe.
Detroit Red Wings history features hall-of-famer Steve Yzerman.
Grand Rapids Griffins are AHL affiliate of Detroit Red Wings.
Toledo Walleye are ECHL affiliate of Detroit Red Wings.
